title.narrative: Brussels VIII Conference - Signature of the Service Level Agreement (SLA) for the Organisation of the International Conference on ''Supporting the Future of Syria and the Region'' on 27 May 2024, GSC, amount: EUR 133.133,00

description.narrative:
The organisation of this conference is of the highest political importance involving the participation of high-level political representatives, including Heads of State and Government, 2 Commissioners and the HRVP.

Traditionally, previous editions of the Brussels Conference on ¿Supporting the future of Syria and the region¿ have been hosted by the Council of the European Union and in the Europa building (used by the Council of Ministers of the EU). The Council has the ideal venue for the Ministerial event as it is the only building capable of accommodating the number of representatives who will be invited, including the necessary protocol services and necessary security requirements. The Council will provide for the necessary logistical arrangements needed for the organisation of this international conference. As such, the Council has the required resources in terms of technical knowhow and manpower to ensure the smooth running of this high-level event.

The Council of Ministers has exclusive rights to its building and the General Secretariat of the Council (GSC) is the only possible contracting counterpart. A SLA is foreseen by both institutions rather than a standard service contract. The sums mentioned in the SLA are lower than last year¿s SLA and were provided by Council services according to their estimates, established during consultations with NEAR and the EEAS.

DG NEAR shall transfer EUR 133.133,00 as an advanced payment at the latest before the beginning of the Conference on 27 May. The final invoicing shall be done on the basis of actual costs. There is a clear provision in the SLA Art. 3(2) that the Council will pay back all the unused amounts as was always the case in the past.
